# A searchlight's pool on the roof: a 16-sided disc r 1.0, 0.05 thick (its top 0.1 above the
# origin so it never fights the roof), unlit: a sea-green rim and a mint centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rim --base-color 0.055 0.686 0.608 --no-slot --emission 0.055 0.686 0.608
material new Hot --base-color 0.188 0.882 0.725 --no-slot --emission 0.188 0.882 0.725
add mesh cylinder --name Pool --vertices 16 --radius 1.0 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 0.075
material assign Rim
active Pool
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
inset 0.2
material assign Hot
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export pool.glb
